**Resubmitted — ASSIGN: deviation, redline at preferred level (minimality defect repaired).**

What changed from the prior version:
- The original general consent sentence ("Customer will not assign … such consent not to be unreasonably withheld") is now **restored and untouched** — we no longer silently free Customer to assign to any third party.
- Our affiliate and sale-of-substantially-all-assets rights are expressed as an extension of the existing "Notwithstanding the foregoing" carve-out (op 1), so no consent is required for those transfers.
- Op 2 adds only the IBM-side elements: no assignment without our consent (not unreasonably withheld), an absolute bar on assigning to a competitor of ours, and confirmation that our change of control gives IBM no termination right.
- Retained sentences (void attempted assignments; continuing Customer liability) still operate coherently; no dangling terms or cross-references.
